new_jobs.title: Director, Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Director of Software Engineering leads multiple software engineering teams responsible for the delivery of innovative, scalable, secure, and reliable products and services.

This role partners closely with Product Management, UX, Architecture, Customer Success, and executive leadership to translate business objectives into engineering strategy and execution.

The Director drives organizational effectiveness, technical excellence, operational discipline, and talent development while ensuring successful delivery of business-critical initiatives.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Define and execute engineering strategies that align with organizational and product objectives.
Develop and communicate long-term technology roadmaps and investment priorities.
Drive innovation through adoption of modern engineering practices, tools, and technologies.
Anticipate technical and organizational risks and implement mitigation strategies.

Engineering Execution

Lead the delivery of multiple software products, platforms, or engineering portfolios.
Ensure predictable execution against roadmap commitments, balancing speed, quality, security, and scalability.
Establish metrics, KPIs, and operational reviews to measure team performance and delivery outcomes.
Drive continuous improvement across software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps, CI/CD, and engineering operations.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers and high-performing software engineering teams.
Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and growth-oriented culture.
Drive organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and talent development strategies.
Recruit, retain, and develop top engineering talent.

Technical Leadership

Influence architecture and platform decisions to ensure scalability, availability, maintainability, and security.
Champion engineering best practices, coding standards, testing strategies, and operational excellence.
Partner with engineering and architecture leaders to drive technical direction and modernization initiatives.
Ensure compliance with security, privacy, regulatory, and governance requirements.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate closely with Product Management to align engineering priorities with customer and business needs.
Partner with Design, IT, Security, Sales, Customer Success, and Support teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
Effectively communicate technical strategy, project status, risks, and business impact to senior leadership and stakeholders.
Influence and align cross-functional teams to achieve strategic objectives.

Job Requirements

12+ years of software engineering experience.
5+ years of people leadership experience managing managers and/or multiple engineering teams.
Experience leading large-scale software development initiatives from concept through delivery.
Strong knowledge of software architecture, cloud technologies, distributed systems, DevOps, and Agile methodologies.
Experience driving organizational change and scaling engineering organizations.
Proven ability to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or MBA.
Experience building and leading geographically distributed engineering teams.
Experience with SaaS, cloud-native platforms, AI/ML-enabled solutions, or enterprise software products.
Strong financial and operational management experience, including resource planning and budget accountability.
Demonstrated success driving digital transformation and modernization initiatives.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

Compensation

The target salary range for this position is 227,800 - 338,800 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off, various Leave options, Performance-Based Incentives, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s), with all offerings subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. Benefits may vary by country and region, and further details will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

new_jobs.title: VP of Engineering, Storage Protocols
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

VP of Engineering, Distributed Storage Services & Protocols

The Opportunity

Storage is having its moment again — AI training and inference workloads are forcing a rethink of how data is stored, moved, and served at scale, and NetApp sits at the center of that shift. As VP of Engineering for Distributed Storage Services & Protocols, you'll own the technical strategy and execution for File (NAS), Block (SAN), and Object (S3) across ONTAP and StorageGRID. Your central mandate is guiding these teams to meet the performance, quality, and scale demands that AI workloads are placing on the protocol stack — from high-concurrency training-data access to inference-time latency and reliability at scale — while keeping the enterprise workloads that are our foundation running without compromise.

This is a build-and-lead role for someone who wants deep technical ownership at VP scope: real architectural influence — shaping direction in close partnership with principal architects — a seat in executive strategy discussions, and a mandate to build and sustain a high-performing engineering organization that can meet the next generation of workloads.

Role

Reports to: SVP of Platform Engineering

Location: Remote-friendly — we're flexible on where you're based. Our senior leadership team is primarily based in San Jose, CA, and this role should expect to spend meaningful time there.

Scope: Leads engineering across File, Block, Object, and StorageGRID protocol teams — an organization of roughly 350 engineers.

Job Requirements

What You Will Own

Technical strategy and execution across ONTAP's File (NFS, SMB, multiprotocol), Block (iSCSI, FC, NVMe/TCP, NVMe/FC), and Object (S3) protocol teams, plus the StorageGRID engineering organization.
Building, developing, and retaining a high-performing, multi-layered engineering leadership team across File, Block, Object, and StorageGRID — with real focus on sustainable team health and long-term retention, not just delivery velocity.
The architectural roadmap for object storage across the portfolio — including how performance-oriented ONTAP S3 and capacity/throughput-oriented StorageGRID object storage differentiate and integrate — in close partnership with Product Management and principal architects, so engineering investment stays coherent rather than duplicative.
The technical roadmap for multiprotocol data access that balances enterprise workload modernization with emerging AI/ML training, inference, and data-lakehouse use cases.
Reliability, performance, and scale for the protocol stack, including executive-level ownership of major customer escalations involving protocol behavior at scale.
Standards participation and protocol compliance (NFS, SMB, iSCSI, FC, NVMe, S3, Tables) to keep NetApp interoperable across enterprise and hyperscaler ecosystems.
Organizational design for where protocol and control-plane capabilities sit within Platform Engineering — grounded in evidence like backlog composition and ownership boundaries.
Close partnership with peer engineering leaders across ONTAP Core, Manageability, and Data Replication (MetroCluster, SnapMirror) to keep the broader storage platform architecturally coherent.
A voice in executive technical strategy, including NetApp's technical narrative on object and metadata architecture for neocloud customers.

Required

What We're Looking For

15+ years of engineering leadership in storage, infrastructure, or platform software, including 8+ years leading multiple layers of engineering management, with a track record of building distributed, horizontally scalable, and fault-tolerant systems.

Primary Duties

The CTIO develops and drives a comprehensive, forward-looking technology strategy that aligns with organizational priorities and positions the organization for sustainable growth. This position spearheads the modernization, integration, and optimization of core enterprise systems to ensure scalability, reliability, and interoperability. Qualifications

12+ years of progressive experience in technology leadership, with at least 5 years in senior or executive-level roles.
Foundational experience as a hands-on technology practitioner (e.g., software engineering, systems architecture, infrastructure, data engineering, or cybersecurity).

Experience guiding enterprise-wide system implementations and integrations.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, automation, and cybersecurity best practices.
Experience establishing data governance and analytics capabilities.
Proven ability to manage budgets, vendors, and cross-functional partnerships.

You will work with C-suite executives, private equity clients, and IT leadership to identify, plan, and execute healthcare technology-driven strategies that enable innovate delivery of patient care, operational efficiencies with health plans, optimize enterprise IT platforms and optimize operational costs while also accelerating revenue and digital innovation during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and carve-outs as well as value creation, enterprise re-imagine, and technology transformation initiatives . This role blends deep IT expertise with strategic insight to deliver measurable value through cost transformation, digital/AI enablement, operational efficiency, and tech-enabled growth initiatives.

Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Deal Technology Health practice works on the most complex and high-profile healthcare transactions, across a broad portfolio of clients. We are a group of experienced industry professionals with a background in healthcare enterprise technology who are serial transaction and strategic advisers, which enables us to bring a wealth of deep sector and functional knowledge to our clients. This role is focused on advising the Health sector. As a team, we prepare and execute separation and integration plans, identify ideas and sources of value enhancement, as well as advise on risk mitigation and the successful change of enterprise technology platforms, operations, functions, and people.

Key Responsibilities

As a Director with EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution Deal Technology – Health practice, you will lead value-creation technology projects that span cost optimization and growth enablement. You’ll guide clients through IT-focused strategies that enhance operational efficiency and unlock new revenue opportunities. Your role will involve advising senior stakeholders, collaborating across functions, and applying emerging technologies (Clinical and revenue cycle management platforms, AI, cloud, data analytics) to deliver measurable business impact. A strong commercial mindset and the ability to balance efficiency with innovation are essential to success in this role.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Build Trusted Relationships - ability to manage senior client relationships and influence client perspectives.
Strong Problem Solving and Storytelling - be a lead for solving problems from beginning to end (problem identification, hypothesis development, synthesis, and recommendation with a compelling narrative).
Outcomes-driven - understand and translate client needs into approach and outcomes for project delivery.
Effective through Collaboration - be part of project teams comprising colleagues from across the EY-Parthenon sub-service lines.
Business and Commercially Driven - working in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.
Business Development - ability to drive aspects of pursuits, including presentations and client meetings. Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work.
Talent Development - coach junior colleagues to become high-performing.
Learning - learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences.

To qualify, you must have

A bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Information and Operations Management, Analytics or related field and 5 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 3 years of related work experience.
Experience in a healthcare professional services firm or health technology company, IT strategy, digital transformation, and transaction advisory.
Expertise in the following IT skillsets:
Hands-on technical Implementation experience of a major acute EHR platforms (Epic or Cerner) and/or ambulatory platforms (Epic, AthenaHealth, Nextgen, eClinicalworks, etc.)
Enterprise architecture of clinical platforms and revenue cycle management platforms including integration engines such as Cloverleaf, Mirth Connect, or Boomi
Enterprise or solution architecture for modern enterprise/back-office and admin application platforms
Software centric product environments (SaaS, cloud native, API based ecosystems)
Software architecture and custom application development (e.g., Java, C#, Python, APIs, and Data lake platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Fabric)
Network infrastructure architecture and design (LAN/WLAN, Internet Edge, Zero Trust Security Framework), and SD-WAN
Azure AD, EntraID, MFA, PAM/IAM experience a plus

Certifications in TOGAF®, Agile Scrum (CSM), or ITIL, highly desired.
Proven experience in cost optimization (e.g., AI/Digital Transformation, IT synergy planning, post-merger integration or carve-out execution) and in tech-driven growth initiatives (e.g., implementing a new digital product, scaling technology to deliver excellence of patient, provider, and employee experience).
Ability to synthesize complex technical, financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights; balanced cost efficiency with innovative tech-driven growth strategies.
Comprehensive understanding of IT cost structures – including TCO (total cost of ownership), shared services, outsourcing, and digital transformation levers and an ability to convert various technology/IT opportunities into dollar and financial impact.
Experience in merger & acquisition contexts – e.g., involvement in IT due diligence, IT separation or integration projects, or identifying technology synergies in deals. Understanding deal timelines and how to realize value quickly in a deal timeline is critical.
Leadership & Soft Skills: Proven ability to lead teams and drive change. Excellent client-facing skills with experience advising senior executives. A track record of influencing decision-makers and driving initiatives to completion, especially where technology and business strategy intersect.
You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you will have

An MBA, Masters in Computer Science/Engineering, Data Analytics or other relevant advanced degree, reflecting the strategic and cross-disciplinary nature of the role.
Emerging Tech Familiarity: Exposure to modern technology trends such as artificial intelligence (experience with tools like Microsoft Copilot or other AI platforms), IoT, or advanced data analytics in a business context. Being able to bring cutting-edge ideas to clients is a plus by assessing and prioritizing emerging technologies based on their cost-benefit impact across.
Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
Network & Thought Leadership: Established networking skills and a presence in the industry (e.g., speaking at conferences, publishing thought leadership on technology value creation). This signals passion and recognition in the field.

What We Look For

We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $220,000 to $235,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

In a rapidly evolving technology and cybersecurity landscape, clients across all industries look to EY for trusted solutions to address increasingly complex risks, threats, and transformation initiatives.

capability within our National Consulting Microsoft Business Applications practice. This capability is part of EY’s strategic Microsoft partnership and broader value creation initiative

.

.

Solution Offering Lead, focused on delivery, capability build, and transformation execution
Microsoft Enterprise Platform Architect, leading solutioning, deal shaping, and pre-sales strategy

Solution Offering Leads (Delivery & Capability Build)

Responsible for building, scaling, and delivering Microsoft Enterprise Platform solutions across core domains. These leaders drive engagement delivery, capability development, and transformation outcomes
.

Microsoft Enterprise Platform Architects (Pre-Sales & Solutioning)

Design and implement enterprise-scale Microsoft solutions aligned to business outcomes
Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across security, identity, data, and cloud architecture
Collaborate across sales, architecture, and delivery teams to drive successful client outcomes
Support the growth and scaling of EY’s Microsoft Enterprise Platform capability

Solution Offering Leads

Lead complex transformation programs and enterprise-scale delivery engagements
Build and scale solution offerings across AI, Security, and Cloud domains
Drive delivery excellence, governance frameworks, and quality standards
Lead implementations across Microsoft technologies, including:
Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
Microsoft Defender Suite (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365)
Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM/SOAR)
Microsoft Purview (Data Security & Compliance)
Azure Security capabilities (Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, Policy)

Build, mentor, and lead high-performing consulting teams

Microsoft Enterprise Platform Architects

Lead solution architecture and deal shaping for large-scale Microsoft platform opportunities, including enterprise transformation programs across finance, supply chain, and operational domains
Design end-to-end enterprise platform solutions across:
Azure (cloud infrastructure and platform services)
Microsoft 365, including Copilot and collaboration platforms
Microsoft Security stack (Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel, Purview)
Data and AI platforms

Translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable, secure architectures
Support proposals, RFP responses, and executive-level client presentations
Partner with Solution Offering Leads to ensure alignment from sales through delivery

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field
10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, cloud, AI, or enterprise technology
Experience working within the Microsoft ecosystem, including Azure, Microsoft 365, Security, AI, or Dynamics
Demonstrated ability to operate across both:
Sales (pre-sales, proposals, solutioning)
Delivery (execution, program leadership)

Experience supporting solutioning, proposals, or pre-sales activities within complex Microsoft environments
Strong client-facing consulting experience managing senior stakeholders

Ideally, you’ll also have

Microsoft certifications (Azure, Security, AI, or Copilot-related certifications)
Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP
Experience building or scaling practices, offerings, or teams
Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST, ISO, MITRE, or Zero Trust architectures
Experience supporting AI, data modernization, or cloud transformation initiatives

Additional Requirements

Willingness to travel approximately 40–50%, depending on client and engagement needs

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $204,800 to $443,200. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.

new_jobs.description:
Job Duties

JOB DESCRIPTION

Windows Platform Security Engineer to design and maintain comprehensive security controls across enterprise Windows ecosystem. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise spanning operating system hardening, endpoint protection, identity governance, modern workplace technologies, and hybrid cloud environments.

Design, implement, and maintain security baselines and hardening standards across the Windows platform (client and server operating systems).
Administer and optimize endpoint security tooling, including EDR/XDR, antivirus, and threat detection solutions.
Manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls, including authentication, authorization, privileged access, and conditional access policies.
Secure modern workplace solutions including Windows Desktops, productivity solutions, and enterprise browser deployments.
Architect and enforce network security controls across on-premises and cloud environments, including proxy and web gateway solutions.
Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, and Cyber Defense teams to ensure consistent security posture across hybrid environments.
Conduct vulnerability assessments and remediation planning.
Apply security best practices to harden OSes, maintain secure configurations and reduce host attack surface.
Draft security policies, standards and procedures.
Contribute to technical and business discussions for security strategy with an emerging threat landscape.
Design and develop for shared services, workflows and processes for on-premises and hybrid (on prem + cloud) solutions.
Design for integrated security controls, workflows, data protection, authentication and authorization.
Design security for monitoring, logging, IAM, encryption, data protection, detection and preventive controls.
Advise and design with commercial and open-source security tools and controls.
Stay up to date with cybersecurity threats, risks and vulnerabilities with potential impact on services.

Skills And Experience

At least eight-plus years’ experience in Windows platform security or a related role.
Proficient with security configuration management tools
Ability to influence technical teams, business units and collaborate to reduce attack surface.
Capacity to comprehend complex technical infrastructure, identities, access controls and least privilege.
Strong written and oral communication skills across varying levels of the organization.

Windows Operating System Security

In-depth knowledge of Windows OS hardening (Workstations and Windows Servers).
Experience with Group Policy (GPO), Security Baselines, and hardening Benchmarks.

Endpoint Security Tools

Experience with EDR/XDR platforms.
Configuration of endpoint protection, threat hunting, and automated remediation.
Experience with patch management and endpoint compliance / mobile device management tooling.

Identity & Access Management (IAM)

Understanding of identity & access management solutions.
Implementation of Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
Understanding of authentication protocols (Kerberos, NTLM, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).
Experience with Single Sign-On (SSO) and identity lifecycle governance.

Windows Desktops & Modern Workplace

Experience securing Windows Desktop deployments.
Knowledge of provisioning policies, security baselines, and access controls for Windows Desktops.
Experience with modern workplace productivity tooling on desktop

Browser Security

Experience managing and securing enterprise browsers
Configuration of browser policies, extension governance, and safe browsing controls.

Networking & Proxy Solutions

Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls).
Experience with proxy and secure web gateway solutions.
Knowledge of network segmentation, Zero Trust networking, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) concepts.

Cloud Security

Demonstrable experience securing cloud environments.
Familiarity with network security groups (NSGs).
Understanding of hybrid identity, RBAC, and cloud security posture management (CSPM).
Experience managing security across both on-premises and cloud (hybrid) architectures.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

Job Description:

The Associate Vice President must be capable of overseeing project teams managing the planning, evaluation, design, construction, and rehabilitation of water and wastewater treatment facilities and related infrastructure, including water supply systems, surface water and groundwater treatment plants, pump stations, and raw and potable water conveyance systems. The AVP operates at a strategic level, guiding project execution, mentoring managers and senior staff, supporting business development efforts, and serving as a key liaison between technical teams and executive, administrative, and financial leadership. This position represents the company in client, industry, and community settings and plays a critical role in sustaining long-term growth and client relationships.

Responsibilities

Lead multidisciplinary project teams through all phases of project delivery, as well as overseeing feasibility studies, engineering analyses, modeling, and the development of innovative, practical solutions.
Mentor, and supervise managers, project leaders, and senior technical staff; support professional development and succession planning.
Manage multiple teams and complex projects concurrently, ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.
Review and approve proposals, scopes of work, budgets, and client agreements to ensure alignment with company standards and business objectives.
Support business development activities, including pursuit strategy, proposal development, RFQs/RFPs, and client interviews.
Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with clients, public agencies, industry partners, and community leaders.
Ensure consistent application and advancement of company design, production, and quality control standards across projects and teams.
Collaborate with executive leadership, operations, and finance to assess staffing needs, resource allocation, and market conditions.
Represent the company through active participation in professional associations, industry organizations, and civic groups.

Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree in Civil Engineering (or related engineering discipline where applicable) from an ABET-accredited program.
Licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) in the state(s) required to support project work
Minimum of 12 years of progressive engineering experience, including senior-level project leadership and people management responsibilities.
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor managers, project leaders, and senior technical professionals.
Proven experience managing complex projects, multiple teams, and competing priorities simultaneously.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with clients, public agencies, and internal leadership.
Ability to work Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with additional hours as required to meet project and business needs.

**Asst Director, Information Technology**

Kansas State University

****About This Role****

Housing and Dining Services seeks a self-motivated, collaborative leader

with technical expertise and strong technical translation skills to

manage departmental information technology functions.

Key Responsibilities

**Supervision & Leadership**

Lead and evaluate Help Desk operations, desktop support, system

administration, and technology projects.

Develop student employees through technical training, leadership

development, and professional workforce preparation.

Provide leadership for Tier 1 ResNet operations and Tier 3 support

across critical databases, applications, security, and monitoring

systems.

Represent Housing and Dining Services on campus IT committees and

collaborate with central IT partners.

**Infrastructure & Technical Leadership**

Serve as the primary architect for server and network infrastructure,

overseeing design, configuration, patching, optimization, security, and

ongoing maintenance.

Manage Windows and Linux server environments, VMware virtualization,

Active Directory, file services, and iSCSI storage.

Design and support enterprise network infrastructure, including routing,

TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, VLANs, wireless, NAC, IP subnetting, and IP address

management.

Troubleshoot complex network and system issues using root-cause analysis

and industry-standard tools and technologies.

Ensure high availability, performance, security, and reliability of

critical 24/7 IT services.

**Project & Resource Management**

Lead infrastructure upgrades, system implementations, wireless

enhancements, and new technology deployments across residential, dining,

and retail facilities.

Forecast capacity and technology needs to support long-term planning and

budget decisions.

Coordinate hardware and server installations and manage project budgets

and resources.

Collaborate with campus network teams on enterprise wireless planning,

subnetting, and infrastructure maintenance.

**Customer Service & Operational Support**

Champion a customer-focused ResNet support model and ensure reliable

wired and wireless services for residents.

Conduct site assessments to evaluate network coverage, capacity, and

service quality.

Provide Tier 3 support for complex and mission-critical incidents and

respond to production emergencies on a 24/7 basis as needed.

Foster strong partnerships across departmental and campus IT teams while

promoting collaboration, professionalism, and a positive service

environment.

About Child Mind Institute

We're dedicated to transforming the lives of children and families struggling with mental health and learning disorders by giving them the help they need. We've become the leading independent nonprofit in children's mental health by providing gold-standard evidence-based care, delivering educational resources to millions of families each year, training educators in underserved communities, and developing tomorrow's breakthrough treatments.

Position Details

As part of the IT team, you will report to the Chief Technology Officer. As the Director, Business Technology, you will be responsible for translating the needs of the organization’s business divisions into technology-enabled solutions that improve effectiveness, efficiency, and impact.

You will partner closely with departments and their leaders to deeply understand their mission, goals, and operational challenges, and identify opportunities to improve how they deliver on their mandates through technology, data, and process innovation. You will act as a strategic liaison between the business and the Technology organization, ensuring priorities are clear, aligned, and effectively delivered.

This is an exempt, full-time position requiring a minimum of four (4) days per week in the office, on a schedule determined by your supervisor located in our NYC headquarters office. The in-office requirement and schedule are subject to change based on the needs of the program and the organization.

You Will

Build deep partnerships with business units to understand their goals, workflows, and challenges, and how they deliver value to the organization.
Identify and develop opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness through technology-enabled solutions, including process optimization, SaaS platforms, automation, AI, and data/analytics.
Prioritize initiatives based on cost-to-value, speed-to-value, and strategic alignment across the organization.
Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the Technology organization, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and accountability.
Champion business priorities within IT to ensure appropriate focus, resourcing, and execution.
Develop and maintain a cross-functional roadmap and portfolio of initiatives aligned to organizational objectives.
Communicate the “why,” expected outcomes, and progress of initiatives to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Ensure delivery of solutions that drive measurable improvements in business performance and impact.
Collaborate with IT leadership to align initiatives with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and integration standards.
Guide the selection and implementation of technology solutions that enable business outcomes across core systems, analytics platforms, and emerging capabilities.
Establish continuous feedback loops with business partners to evaluate impact and refine priorities over time.
Foster a culture of partnership, accountability, and outcome-driven delivery across business and technology teams.
Perform additional job-related duties as assigned.

You Have

Bachelor’s degree in computer information systems, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of leadership experience in technology, product, or business-facing IT roles.
Proven ability to partner with business stakeholders to deliver technology-enabled solutions that drive measurable outcomes.
Experience in strategic planning, program and project management, and process improvement initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, data and analytics, and system integration approaches.
Knowledge of integration technologies such as APIs, HL7, FHIR, web services, JSON, XML, and business process automation tools.
Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical and prioritization skills, with a focus on delivering business value.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional change and drive adoption of new solutions.

Our Benefits

Our great compensation package and benefits include medical insurance, 401(k), paid parental leave, dependent care, discounted tickets and entertainment perks programs. For more information about our benefits, please visit our employee benefits website .

Pay Range

The salary range for the position is posted. Factors such as candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations affect the salary offered within this range. In addition, this salary may be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state and depending on the role), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.

Build and scale solution offerings across AI, Security, and Cloud domains

Demonstrated ability to operate across both:
Sales (pre-sales, proposals, solutioning)
Delivery (execution, program leadership)

Experience supporting solutioning, proposals, or pre-sales activities within complex Microsoft environments
Strong client-facing consulting experience managing senior stakeholders

The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $204,800 to $443,200. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. new_jobs.description:
Location: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Hoboken, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, San Francisco

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY-Parthenon – Strategy & Execution – Deal Technology Health – Enterprise Architect - Director

The opportunity

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.

With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

As a Director in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy & Execution – Deal Technology practice focusing on Health IT, you will lead high-impact engagements that drive both cost optimization and top-line growth across complex transactions and corporate transformations. You will work with C-suite executives, private equity clients, and IT leadership to identify, plan, and execute healthcare technology-driven strategies that enable innovate delivery of patient care, operational efficiencies with health plans, optimize enterprise IT platforms and optimize operational costs while also accelerating revenue and digital innovation during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and carve-outs as well as value creation, enterprise re-imagine, and technology transformation initiatives . This role blends deep IT expertise with strategic insight to deliver measurable value through cost transformation, digital/AI enablement, operational efficiency, and tech-enabled growth initiatives.

Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Deal Technology Health practice works on the most complex and high-profile healthcare transactions, across a broad portfolio of clients. We are a group of experienced industry professionals with a background in healthcare enterprise technology who are serial transaction and strategic advisers, which enables us to bring a wealth of deep sector and functional knowledge to our clients. This role is focused on advising the Health sector. As a team, we prepare and execute separation and integration plans, identify ideas and sources of value enhancement, as well as advise on risk mitigation and the successful change of enterprise technology platforms, operations, functions, and people.

Key Responsibilities

As a Director with EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution Deal Technology – Health practice, you will lead value-creation technology projects that span cost optimization and growth enablement. You’ll guide clients through IT-focused strategies that enhance operational efficiency and unlock new revenue opportunities. Your role will involve advising senior stakeholders, collaborating across functions, and applying emerging technologies (Clinical and revenue cycle management platforms, AI, cloud, data analytics) to deliver measurable business impact. A strong commercial mindset and the ability to balance efficiency with innovation are essential to success in this role.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Build Trusted Relationships - ability to manage senior client relationships and influence client perspectives.
Strong Problem Solving and Storytelling - be a lead for solving problems from beginning to end (problem identification, hypothesis development, synthesis, and recommendation with a compelling narrative).
Outcomes-driven - understand and translate client needs into approach and outcomes for project delivery.
Effective through Collaboration - be part of project teams comprising colleagues from across the EY-Parthenon sub-service lines.
Business and Commercially Driven - working in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.
Business Development - ability to drive aspects of pursuits, including presentations and client meetings. Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work.
Talent Development - coach junior colleagues to become high-performing.
Learning - learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences.

To qualify, you must have

A bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Information and Operations Management, Analytics or related field and 5 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 3 years of related work experience.
Experience in a healthcare professional services firm or health technology company, IT strategy, digital transformation, and transaction advisory.
Expertise in the following IT skillsets:
Hands-on technical Implementation experience of a major acute EHR platforms (Epic or Cerner) and/or ambulatory platforms (Epic, AthenaHealth, Nextgen, eClinicalworks, etc.)
Enterprise architecture of clinical platforms and revenue cycle management platforms including integration engines such as Cloverleaf, Mirth Connect, or Boomi
Enterprise or solution architecture for modern enterprise/back-office and admin application platforms
Software centric product environments (SaaS, cloud native, API based ecosystems)
Software architecture and custom application development (e.g., Java, C#, Python, APIs, and Data lake platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Fabric)
Network infrastructure architecture and design (LAN/WLAN, Internet Edge, Zero Trust Security Framework), and SD-WAN
Azure AD, EntraID, MFA, PAM/IAM experience a plus

Certifications in TOGAF®, Agile Scrum (CSM), or ITIL, highly desired.
Proven experience in cost optimization (e.g., AI/Digital Transformation, IT synergy planning, post-merger integration or carve-out execution) and in tech-driven growth initiatives (e.g., implementing a new digital product, scaling technology to deliver excellence of patient, provider, and employee experience).
Ability to synthesize complex technical, financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights; balanced cost efficiency with innovative tech-driven growth strategies.
Comprehensive understanding of IT cost structures – including TCO (total cost of ownership), shared services, outsourcing, and digital transformation levers and an ability to convert various technology/IT opportunities into dollar and financial impact.
Experience in merger & acquisition contexts – e.g., involvement in IT due diligence, IT separation or integration projects, or identifying technology synergies in deals. Understanding deal timelines and how to realize value quickly in a deal timeline is critical.
Leadership & Soft Skills: Proven ability to lead teams and drive change. Excellent client-facing skills with experience advising senior executives. A track record of influencing decision-makers and driving initiatives to completion, especially where technology and business strategy intersect.
You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you will have

An MBA, Masters in Computer Science/Engineering, Data Analytics or other relevant advanced degree, reflecting the strategic and cross-disciplinary nature of the role.
Emerging Tech Familiarity: Exposure to modern technology trends such as artificial intelligence (experience with tools like Microsoft Copilot or other AI platforms), IoT, or advanced data analytics in a business context. Being able to bring cutting-edge ideas to clients is a plus by assessing and prioritizing emerging technologies based on their cost-benefit impact across.
Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
Network & Thought Leadership: Established networking skills and a presence in the industry (e.g., speaking at conferences, publishing thought leadership on technology value creation). This signals passion and recognition in the field.

What We Look For

We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $220,000 to $235,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

new_jobs.description:
Location: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Hoboken, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, San Francisco

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY-Parthenon – Strategy & Execution – Deal Technology Health – Enterprise Architect - Director

The opportunity

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.

With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

As a Director in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy & Execution – Deal Technology practice focusing on Health IT, you will lead high-impact engagements that drive both cost optimization and top-line growth across complex transactions and corporate transformations. You will work with C-suite executives, private equity clients, and IT leadership to identify, plan, and execute healthcare technology-driven strategies that enable innovate delivery of patient care, operational efficiencies with health plans, optimize enterprise IT platforms and optimize operational costs while also accelerating revenue and digital innovation during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and carve-outs as well as value creation, enterprise re-imagine, and technology transformation initiatives . This role blends deep IT expertise with strategic insight to deliver measurable value through cost transformation, digital/AI enablement, operational efficiency, and tech-enabled growth initiatives.

Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Deal Technology Health practice works on the most complex and high-profile healthcare transactions, across a broad portfolio of clients. We are a group of experienced industry professionals with a background in healthcare enterprise technology who are serial transaction and strategic advisers, which enables us to bring a wealth of deep sector and functional knowledge to our clients. This role is focused on advising the Health sector. As a team, we prepare and execute separation and integration plans, identify ideas and sources of value enhancement, as well as advise on risk mitigation and the successful change of enterprise technology platforms, operations, functions, and people.

Key Responsibilities

As a Director with EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution Deal Technology – Health practice, you will lead value-creation technology projects that span cost optimization and growth enablement. You’ll guide clients through IT-focused strategies that enhance operational efficiency and unlock new revenue opportunities. Your role will involve advising senior stakeholders, collaborating across functions, and applying emerging technologies (Clinical and revenue cycle management platforms, AI, cloud, data analytics) to deliver measurable business impact. A strong commercial mindset and the ability to balance efficiency with innovation are essential to success in this role.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Build Trusted Relationships - ability to manage senior client relationships and influence client perspectives.
Strong Problem Solving and Storytelling - be a lead for solving problems from beginning to end (problem identification, hypothesis development, synthesis, and recommendation with a compelling narrative).
Outcomes-driven - understand and translate client needs into approach and outcomes for project delivery.
Effective through Collaboration - be part of project teams comprising colleagues from across the EY-Parthenon sub-service lines.
Business and Commercially Driven - working in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.
Business Development - ability to drive aspects of pursuits, including presentations and client meetings. Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work.
Talent Development - coach junior colleagues to become high-performing.
Learning - learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences.

To qualify, you must have

A bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Information and Operations Management, Analytics or related field and 5 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 3 years of related work experience.
Experience in a healthcare professional services firm or health technology company, IT strategy, digital transformation, and transaction advisory.
Expertise in the following IT skillsets:
Hands-on technical Implementation experience of a major acute EHR platforms (Epic or Cerner) and/or ambulatory platforms (Epic, AthenaHealth, Nextgen, eClinicalworks, etc.)
Enterprise architecture of clinical platforms and revenue cycle management platforms including integration engines such as Cloverleaf, Mirth Connect, or Boomi
Enterprise or solution architecture for modern enterprise/back-office and admin application platforms
Software centric product environments (SaaS, cloud native, API based ecosystems)
Software architecture and custom application development (e.g., Java, C#, Python, APIs, and Data lake platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Fabric)
Network infrastructure architecture and design (LAN/WLAN, Internet Edge, Zero Trust Security Framework), and SD-WAN
Azure AD, EntraID, MFA, PAM/IAM experience a plus

Certifications in TOGAF®, Agile Scrum (CSM), or ITIL, highly desired.
Proven experience in cost optimization (e.g., AI/Digital Transformation, IT synergy planning, post-merger integration or carve-out execution) and in tech-driven growth initiatives (e.g., implementing a new digital product, scaling technology to deliver excellence of patient, provider, and employee experience).
Ability to synthesize complex technical, financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights; balanced cost efficiency with innovative tech-driven growth strategies.
Comprehensive understanding of IT cost structures – including TCO (total cost of ownership), shared services, outsourcing, and digital transformation levers and an ability to convert various technology/IT opportunities into dollar and financial impact.
Experience in merger & acquisition contexts – e.g., involvement in IT due diligence, IT separation or integration projects, or identifying technology synergies in deals. Understanding deal timelines and how to realize value quickly in a deal timeline is critical.
Leadership & Soft Skills: Proven ability to lead teams and drive change. Excellent client-facing skills with experience advising senior executives. A track record of influencing decision-makers and driving initiatives to completion, especially where technology and business strategy intersect.
You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you will have

An MBA, Masters in Computer Science/Engineering, Data Analytics or other relevant advanced degree, reflecting the strategic and cross-disciplinary nature of the role.
Emerging Tech Familiarity: Exposure to modern technology trends such as artificial intelligence (experience with tools like Microsoft Copilot or other AI platforms), IoT, or advanced data analytics in a business context. Being able to bring cutting-edge ideas to clients is a plus by assessing and prioritizing emerging technologies based on their cost-benefit impact across.
Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
Network & Thought Leadership: Established networking skills and a presence in the industry (e.g., speaking at conferences, publishing thought leadership on technology value creation). This signals passion and recognition in the field.

What We Look For

We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $220,000 to $235,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. new_jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

Across AKTG, our products are experiences built on destination expertise, trusted local relationships, and exceptional service. The Chief Product Officer will own the AKTG product portfolio, defined as the end‑to‑end guest experience across journeys, destinations, owned assets, and the ecosystem that delivers them, including A&K journeys, A&K private jet, all A&K Sanctuaries (A&K’s owned assets), destination management companies (DMCs), Crystal itineraries and shore excursions, and global procurement. The role balances protection of brand heritage with purposeful evolution, ensuring the group continues to develop while remaining true to what has made its brands trusted for decades. Success in this role will be measured by guest loyalty, sustainable margin growth, and the long‑term relevance of the AKTG product portfolio.

Essential Job Duties

Owning the global product vision across all AKTG brands, journeys, destinations, DMCs, and assets, and translating this into clear priorities and standards.
Evolving existing products and branded experiences while selectively introducing new concepts that add long‑term value and remain authentic to the brands.
Owning DMCs as core products, accountable for quality, commercial performance, and scalability, while driving consistency and collaboration under a “One A&K” approach.
Leading destination expansion decisions from opportunity assessment through launch, balancing central standards with strong local expertise and entrepreneurship.
Managing the full product lifecycle, including design, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and allocation, with disciplined processes to test, scale, or stop initiatives.
Defining and owning product KPIs covering guest experience, revenue, margin, and profitability, and assessing feasibility and returns for all major initiatives.
Leading business cases for new destinations, assets, partnerships, acquisitions, and capital investments, and presenting recommendations to senior leadership and the Board.
Owning product direction and performance across all owned assets, Crystal itineraries, and shore excursions, ensuring integration into destinations, alignment to group standards, and strong commercial outcomes.
Owning AKTG group procurement strategy with Finance and Operations, leveraging scale while preserving destination authenticity and flexibility where required.
Using guest insight and data to inform product decisions, going beyond satisfaction scores to understand loyalty, advocacy, and value drivers.
Building, leading, and developing a high‑performing global product organization, including regional and functional leadership, with clear accountability and succession planning.
Establishing operating models, governance, and decision‑making frameworks that enable consistency, collaboration, and scalable growth across all brands and geographies.

Other Duties

Collaborating with stakeholders such as sales, IT, marketing, finance & revenue management to maximize opportunities and profitability.

Maintains commercial relationships within the travel industry in key markets.

Travel to local offices to maintain and develop high-level relationships across the market.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Functions, duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Education

Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent executive experience; Master’s degree strongly preferred (MBA, Engineering, Business, or equivalent).

Experience

Minimum 10 years of senior leadership experience within a multinational organisation.
Background in a top‑tier consulting firm and/or complex global company preferred.
Proven experience owning and scaling multi‑region product or service portfolios.
Strong commercial acumen, including ownership of budgets, performance, and investment decisions.
Master’s degree preferred, ideally in Engineering, Business, or equivalent.
Fluent in English plus at least one additional language, preferably Spanish, Italian, or French.
Comfortable operating across cultures, brands, and geographies.
Willingness to travel internationally up to 50 percent.

Skills

Demonstrated organizational and leadership skills.
Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communications skills.
Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and analytical skills required.

Work Environment

This role operates in a global business environment and requires extensive international travel.

Expected Hours of Work

The position is full-time and frequently requires working additional time outside of normal business hours.

Emergency Duty 24/7 phone coverage may be required.
Evening and weekend hours may be required.
